projects.name: GreyHound Quadruped Robot
projects.description: A quadruped legged robot platform using servo actuation, IMU feedback, and Jetson-based high-level control.
projects.details: Designed as a robotics research platform combining embedded control, sensor feedback, and high-level AI/ROS-based planning. The system uses STM32-level control for low-level motor behavior and Jetson-based computation for higher-level processing. The goal is to create a modular legged robotics platform that can later support autonomous navigation, stabilization, and research testing.

projects.name: Automated N8N Workflow System
projects.description: A system for automating data processing and task management using N8N workflows.
projects.details: Designed and implemented an automated workflow system using N8N to streamline data processing and task management. The system integrates various APIs and services to automate repetitive tasks, improve efficiency, and enable seamless data flow across different platforms.

projects.name: Humanoid Head with Integrated AI
projects.description: A humanoid head prototype featuring integrated AI for facial recognition and expression generation.
projects.details: This project involves designing and implementing a humanoid head with integrated artificial intelligence capabilities. The system focuses on facial recognition and expression generation, utilizing advanced computer vision and machine learning techniques.

projects.name: Garbage Segmentation System
projects.description: Computer vision system for detecting and classifying waste objects for automated sorting.
projects.details: A vision-based waste classification and segmentation system intended for smart garbage sorting. The system focuses on identifying different types of waste and supporting automated disposal decisions.
